# fct_intake_forms

`data-warehouse-359101.analytics.fct_intake_forms` · dbt area: `portal`

Fact table for client intake form submissions, representing how clients (or potential clients) interact with the forms sent by advisors. Each row represents a form submission (including submissions that may be incomplete). Sourced from the Portal database.

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `form_id` | Primary Key. Unique ID assigned to each intake form. >> SOURCE - Portal data_tests: - unique - not_null |
| `advisor_id` | Foreign Key. The User ID of the Advisor who created the intake form. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `archived_at` | When the intake form was archived by an Advisor. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `client_id` | Foreign Key. The unique identifier for the Client who the form was created for. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `client_completed_at` | When the client completed the intake form. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `client_created_at` | When the client first started filling out the intake form. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `created_at` | When the Advisor created the intake form. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `is_archived` | True/False flag of whether the intake form has been archived. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `is_complete` | True/False flag of whether the client has completed the intake form. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `pages` | Array of page names that the Advisor configured in the intake form (e.g., ['name', 'email', 'phone']). >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `pages_completed_count` | Count of pages the client completed in the intake form. Calculated by counting non-null pages in the responses array. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `pages_created_count` | Count of pages the Advisor configured in the intake form definition. Calculated by counting pages in the pages array. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `responses` | Array of page names that the client completed with non-empty data (e.g., ['name', 'email']). >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `short_id` | Foreign Key. Short alphanumeric identifier for the intake form, used in URLs sent to clients. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `time_to_complete` | Time between form created and form completed in seconds. Null if form not yet completed. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `version` | Intake form release version name. >> SOURCE - Portal |
